subtitle: Jing Wang's notes on programs and research
intro: Hi, I'm Jing Wang, a graduate student at NJU Software Institute. I'm interested in static analysis, programming languages, and algorithms, especially how good models help us reason about real software. Right now, I'm studying lifecycle behavior in HarmonyOS applications and writing down what I learn along the way.

projects.title: HarmonyOS lifecycle analysis
projects.description: Exploring how lifecycle models shape the precision and cost of static analysis for HarmonyOS applications.
